name: Air fryer teriyaki chicken
steps: Toss the chicken in half the teriyaki sauce.
Air fry at 200°C for 15–18 minutes, turning halfway. Brush with the rest of the sauce for the last 3 minutes.
Cook the rice. Steam or stir-fry the pak choi for 3 minutes.
Slice the chicken and scatter with spring onion and sesame seeds.

name: Apple & peanut butter
steps: Slice the apples and serve with the peanut butter for dipping.

name: Beef & veg noodle stir-fry
steps: Cook the noodles, drain and rinse under cold water.
Sear the beef in a very hot wok for 2 minutes, then lift out.
Stir-fry the vegetables and garlic for 3 minutes.
Return the beef with the noodles, soy and honey. Toss for 1 minute.

name: Berry overnight oats
steps: Mix the oats, milk and yoghurt in two jars.
Top with the frozen berries.
Cover and chill overnight. Keeps for 2 days, so it works well across two mornings.

name: Boiled eggs & cherry tomatoes
steps: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, then cool in cold water.
Peel and serve with the tomatoes and a pinch of salt.

name: Chicken & avocado salad box
steps: Griddle the seasoned chicken for 5–6 minutes a side, then slice.
Split the leaves, halved tomatoes and sliced avocado between two boxes.
Top with the chicken and drizzle with oil. Keeps for a day in the fridge.

name: Chicken Caesar wraps
steps: Flatten the chicken slightly, season and griddle for 5–6 minutes a side.
Shred the lettuce and halve the tomatoes. Toss with the dressing.
Slice the chicken and pile into the wraps with the salad and grated cheese.
Roll up tightly and cut in half.

name: Chicken & chorizo pasta bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cook the penne for 2 minutes less than the pack says.
Fry the diced chicken and chorizo for 6 minutes. Add the passata and simmer for 5 minutes.
Mix with the pasta in a baking dish and top with torn mozzarella.
Bake for 15 minutes until bubbling.

name: Chicken fajita traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan).
Slice the chicken, peppers and onion into strips. Toss on a tray with the oil and fajita seasoning.
Roast for 20–25 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is cooked through.
Warm the wraps for the last 2 minutes. Fill with the traybake and a spoon of soured cream.

name: Chicken & hummus wraps
steps: Spread the wraps with hummus.
Add the leaves, sliced cucumber and chicken.
Roll up tightly and cut in half.

name: Chicken noodle soup
steps: Bring 900ml water to the boil with the stock cube and soy sauce.
Add the whole chicken breasts and the sliced carrot. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Lift out the chicken, shred it, and return it to the pan with the noodles for 4 minutes.
Finish with sliced spring onions.

name: Chickpea, feta & couscous salad
steps: Pour 150ml boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Stir in the drained chickpeas, diced cucumber and halved tomatoes.
Dress with lemon juice and top with crumbled feta.

name: Cottage cheese & oatcakes
steps: Spread the cottage cheese on the oatcakes and season with black pepper.

name: Cottage pie
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Boil the peeled potatoes for 15 minutes, then mash with the butter.
Brown the mince with the chopped onion and carrot.
Add the stock cube, Worcestershire sauce and 200ml water. Simmer for 15 minutes, then stir in the peas.
Spoon into a dish, top with the mash and bake for 20 minutes until golden.

name: Creamy mushroom & spinach penne
steps: Cook the penne. Save a mugful of the water before draining.
Fry the sliced mushrooms until golden, then add the garlic.
Stir in the cream cheese with a splash of pasta water to make a sauce. Wilt in the spinach.
Toss with the pasta and finish with grated cheese.

name: Fish finger tacos
steps: Bake the fish fingers following the pack instructions.
Finely shred the cabbage and squeeze over half the lime with a pinch of salt.
Mix the mayo with the sriracha and the rest of the lime juice.
Warm the wraps and fill with slaw, fish fingers and the spicy mayo.

name: Greek chicken rice bowl
steps: Heat the rice pouch.
Dice the cucumber and halve the tomatoes.
Split the rice between two bowls and top with the chicken, veg, crumbled feta and a spoon of yoghurt.

name: Greek yoghurt, berry & granola pot
steps: Thaw the berries in the fridge overnight, or microwave for 1 minute.
Spoon the yoghurt into two bowls or jars.
Top with the berries, granola and a drizzle of honey.

name: Halloumi & chickpea traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan).
Cube the sweet potato and cut the onion into wedges. Toss with the drained chickpeas, oil and harissa.
Roast for 25 minutes.
Add the sliced halloumi on top and roast for 10 more minutes until golden.

name: Honey-soy salmon with rice
steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey and grated garlic. Brush half over the salmon.
Air fry the salmon at 190°C for 10–12 minutes.
Meanwhile cook the rice on the hob. Steam or boil the broccoli for the last 4 minutes.
Spoon the rest of the glaze over the salmon and serve with the rice and broccoli.

name: Hummus & veg sticks
steps: Cut the carrots and half the cucumber into sticks.
Serve with the hummus.

name: Jacket potato with beans & cheese
steps: Prick the potatoes and microwave for 8–10 minutes, turning halfway.
Heat the beans.
Split the potatoes and top with the beans and grated cheese.

name: Leek & potato soup
steps: Slice the leeks and onion and soften gently in a little oil for 10 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes, the stock cube and 900ml water.
Simmer for 20 minutes, then blend until smooth.
Season well and serve with crusty bread.

name: Mushroom stroganoff
steps: Cook the rice.
Soften the sliced onion, then add the mushrooms and cook on a high heat until golden.
Add the garlic and paprika for 1 minute.
Stir in the crème fraîche with a splash of water and bubble for 2 minutes. Serve over the rice.

name: Peanut butter & banana toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with peanut butter.
Top with sliced banana and a pinch of cinnamon if you like.

name: Pesto chicken traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Halve the potatoes and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the chicken, tossed in the pesto, and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and green beans and roast for 10 more minutes.
Check the chicken is cooked through and serve straight from the tray.

name: Prawn egg fried rice
steps: Cook the rice, then spread it on a plate to steam dry (or use leftover cold rice).
Stir-fry the prawns in a hot wok for 2 minutes. Add the peas.
Push everything aside, scramble the eggs, then tip in the rice and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and sliced spring onions.

name: Protein bar
steps: Grab and go.

name: Protein porridge with banana
steps: Simmer the oats and milk for 4–5 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Take off the heat and stir through the skyr.
Top with sliced banana.

name: Red lentil & spinach dal
steps: Soften the onion, then add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the rinsed lentils, coconut milk and 400ml water. Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring.
Cook the rice alongside.
Stir the spinach into the dal until wilted. Season with salt.

name: Red lentil & tomato soup
steps: Soften the chopped onion and carrot in a little oil for 5 minutes.
Add the rinsed lentils, tomatoes, stock cube and 700ml water.
Simmer for 20 minutes, then blend. Good for two days of lunches.

name: Salted edamame
steps: Microwave the edamame for 3–4 minutes.
Sprinkle with sea salt.

name: Sausage & butter bean casserole
steps: Brown the sausages in a casserole pan, then lift out and cut in half.
Soften the sliced onion in the same pan for 5 minutes. Add the paprika.
Return the sausages with the tomatoes and drained beans. Simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve with warm baguette for mopping up.

name: Scrambled eggs & spinach on toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Wilt the spinach in a non-stick pan with the butter, then push to one side.
Add the beaten eggs and stir gently over a low heat until just set.
Season and pile onto the toast.

name: Shakshuka with feta
steps: Soften the sliced onion and pepper for 8 minutes. Add the spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes until thick.
Make 4 wells and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook for 5–6 minutes until the whites set.
Crumble over the feta and serve with bread.

name: Skyr with honey
steps: Spoon the skyr into two pots and drizzle with honey.

name: Slow cooker chicken tikka masala
steps: Put the chicken, sliced onion, curry paste and tomatoes in the slow cooker. Stir well.
Cook on low for 4 hours (or high for 2½).
Cook the rice 15 minutes before serving.
Stir the yoghurt into the curry off the heat. Scatter with coriander.

name: Smoked salmon & cream cheese bagels
steps: Split and toast the bagels.
Spread with cream cheese and top with the salmon.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon and black pepper.

name: Spaghetti bolognese
steps: Brown the mince in a hot pan. Add the finely chopped onion and grated carrot and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, oregano and tomatoes. Simmer for 25 minutes, adding water if it gets thick.
Cook the spaghetti, then toss with the sauce.
Serve with grated cheddar.

name: Sweet potato & black bean burritos
steps: Dice the sweet potato small and fry with the cumin for 10–12 minutes until soft.
Add the drained beans and half the onion. Cook for 3 minutes and lightly mash.
Mash the avocado with the lime juice and the rest of the onion, finely chopped.
Fill the wraps, roll up and toast seam-side down in a dry pan.

name: Thai green veg curry
steps: Fry the curry paste for 1 minute, then add the coconut milk.
Add the cubed sweet potato and drained chickpeas. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the green beans for the last 5 minutes. Cook the rice alongside.
Check the curry paste is vegan if that matters to you; some contain fish sauce.

name: Three-bean veggie chilli
steps: Soften the chopped onion and pepper in a little oil for 6–8 minutes. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Tip in the tomatoes and the drained beans with a splash of water. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook the rice while the chilli simmers.
Season and serve the chilli over the rice.

name: Tofu & edamame rice bowl
steps: Press the tofu dry, cube it and fry until golden on all sides.
Add the soy sauce and toss to coat.
Cook the edamame and rice, then top with the tofu and sesame seeds.

name: Tuna & sweetcorn jacket potatoes
steps: Prick the potatoes, rub with a little oil and salt.
Air fry at 200°C for 40–45 minutes, turning halfway.
Mix the drained tuna and sweetcorn with the mayo and black pepper.
Split the potatoes, pile in the filling and serve with salad.

name: Tuna & sweetcorn pasta salad
steps: Cook the pasta, rinse under cold water and drain.
Mix with the drained tuna, sweetcorn, finely chopped onion and mayo.
Season and split between two boxes.

name: Turkey meatballs in tomato sauce
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Mix the mince, breadcrumbs and egg. Roll into 12 balls.
Bake the meatballs for 15 minutes.
Warm the passata with the garlic, then add the meatballs and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti and serve with the meatballs and sauce.

name: Turkey rasher & egg muffins
steps: Grill or dry-fry the turkey rashers for 3 minutes a side.
Fry the eggs in a non-stick pan.
Toast the muffins and fill with the rashers and egg.

name: Turkey salad sandwich
steps: Spread the bread thinly with mayo.
Layer the turkey, leaves and sliced tomatoes.
Close and cut in half.

name: Veggie omelette
steps: Fry the sliced pepper and mushrooms for 4 minutes, then remove.
Pour in half the beaten eggs and cook until almost set.
Add half the veg and cheese, fold and slide out. Repeat for the second omelette.
